# Brightfield Analytics Employee Handbook

This handbook is a synthetic document created for testing the RAG pipeline. Brightfield Analytics is a fictional company, and none of the information below describes a real organization.

## Working Hours

The standard working week at Brightfield Analytics is 40 hours, from Monday to Friday. Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 local time, and all employees must be available during core hours. Employees may start their day between 07:00 and 10:00. Overtime must be approved in advance by the employee's direct manager.

## Annual Leave

Employees receive 20 days of annual paid leave per calendar year. Annual leave requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least 10 working days before the first day of leave. Up to 5 unused annual leave days can be carried over to the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March of the following year.

## Sick Leave

Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Sick leave does not carry over to the next year. Employees must inform their manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required for any sick leave longer than 3 consecutive working days.

## Parental Leave

The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. The secondary caregiver receives 4 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Parental leave must begin within 12 months of the birth or adoption of the child. Employees become eligible for parental leave after 6 months of continuous employment.

## Remote Work

Employees may work remotely for up to 3 days per week. Remote work arrangements must be agreed with the direct manager and recorded in the HR portal. Tuesday is a mandatory in-office day for all teams. Employees working remotely must use the company VPN and be reachable on the company chat tool during core hours.

## Expense Reimbursement

Business expenses must be submitted in the finance portal within 30 days of the purchase date. Every expense claim must include an itemized receipt. Meal expenses during business travel are reimbursed up to 50 USD per day. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary payment.

## Travel Policy

All business travel must be approved by the department head before any booking is made. Flights shorter than 6 hours must be booked in economy class. Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 180 USD per night. Travel bookings must be made through the company travel agency, Skyline Travel Desk.

## Security Training

All employees must complete the information security awareness course within their first 14 days of employment. The course must be repeated every 12 months. Employees who miss the annual deadline have their system access suspended until the course is completed. Suspected phishing emails must be reported to security@brightfield.example.

## Office Access

The office at 42 Harbor Street is open from 07:00 to 21:00 on weekdays. Employees enter the building with a personal access badge. Lost badges must be reported to the facilities team within 24 hours. Visitors must be registered at reception and escorted by an employee at all times.

## Laptop Policy

Every employee receives a company laptop on their first day. Engineers receive a 16-inch laptop with 32 GB of memory, and all other employees receive a 14-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory. Laptops are replaced every 3 years. A lost or stolen laptop must be reported to the IT helpdesk within 4 hours. Installing unapproved software on a company laptop is not permitted.

## Performance Reviews

Performance reviews take place twice a year, in April and October. Each review includes a self-assessment, manager feedback, and a goal-setting discussion. Salary adjustments are decided only in the April review. Employees who disagree with their review may request a second review by the department head within 15 days.

## Learning and Development

Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,500 USD. The budget can be used for courses, certifications, books, and conference tickets. Unused learning budget does not carry over to the next year. Employees may spend up to 5 working days per year on approved learning activities.

## Health Benefits

Brightfield Analytics provides private health insurance for all employees from their first day of employment. The insurance covers the employee's spouse and children at no extra cost. An annual health check-up is offered free of charge. Employees also receive a gym allowance of 40 USD per month.

## Code of Conduct

Employees must treat colleagues, customers, and partners with respect. Harassment and discrimination of any kind are not tolerated. Concerns can be reported anonymously through the ethics hotline. Gifts from suppliers worth more than 50 USD must be declined and reported to the compliance team.
